{{Top|leg}}
'''The Procession''' was a pathway that passed through [[Kala'uun Starport]] and linked some of the [[Kala'uun/Legends|city]] caverns together. During the day, a constant stream of traffic used the Procession to move from one cave to another, driving two wheeled carts pulled by [[Rycrit/Legends|rycrits]].
